title: Handler tests with httptest and integration tests

videos.script: go-concurrency taught the testing tools. This lesson points them at a service, and asks how far from the code each test should stand. {{levels}} Closest: one handler, called as a function, with a request built in memory and a recorder for the answer. {{router}} Further out: the whole router on a real port, middleware included. That is where a missing header or a token in the log shows up. {{config}} The configuration gets tests too, and one of them finds a defect that has been there since lesson 14. {{race}} Fifty buyers at once, and a test that passes while being wrong, until the race detector looks at it. {{db}} Last, a real PostgreSQL: a database per test, created and dropped, and the two things only the database can show. {{run}} And what to run on every save, before every commit, and in CI, where a skipped test must never pass for a green one.
